title: DataQ Top-20 change register (2026-11-23, evidence-verified)
verification_notes: Search broken: pagefind imported at '/pagefind/pagefind.js' (root-absolute) -> https://deepmindq.github.io/pagefind/pagefind.js returns 404; typing 'data analytics' on live /search/ returned 0 results.

Forms dead: bundle chunks contain 'process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FORM_ACCESS_KEY' unresolved and the fetch is guarded by truthiness of the key; only .env.example exists -> access_key undefined at export time -> Contact + Newsletter submissions cannot deliver.

Domain split-brain: canonical/og:url/sitemap.xml/robots.txt all point to https://www.dataqsoft.com which serves an interstitial ('One moment, please...'); real content lives on deepmindq.github.io/DataQ.
OG images: single public/og-default.png used site-wide; og:image host is the broken domain.
Analytics: CookieConsent offers 'Accept analytics' but no analytics loader exists anywhere (gtag/plausible/posthog absent).
Social: SiteFooter.tsx line 128 LinkedIn href='#'; social-linkedin.png / social-x.png assets exist unused.
Images: 29 files in public/images for 727 pages; HomeView/DataVisuals contain zero alt attributes (SVG-based, decorative).
Sitemap: lastmod = build timestamp for all URLs; changeFrequency monthly.
Deploy: manual scripts/deploy_gh.sh with /tmp/.ghtoken; no .github/workflows CI. Token missing after sandbox reset.
404 status correct on Pages; page <title> falls back to site-default meta.
Search UX: pagefind index exists in out (npx pagefind --site out runs in export script).

items.change: Make pagefind import basePath-aware: prefix '/pagefind/pagefind.js' with NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH (or use relative path) so /DataQ/pagefind/pagefind.js loads on GitHub Pages
items.why: Site search returns 0 results live (404 on the loader); a 727-page site with no working search

items.change: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_FORM_ACCESS_KEY in the export environment (real web3forms key), rebuild, then verify ContactForm + NewsletterForm with a live submission; add visible error/success states and a mailto fallback when the key is absent
items.why: Every Book-a-Briefing CTA funnels into a form that silently cannot submit; entire lead pipeline is dead

items.change: Resolve domain split-brain: either attach www.dataqsoft.com properly to GitHub Pages (CNAME file + DNS A/CNAME records + HTTPS enable) and confirm it serves real content, or repoint NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to https://deepmindq.github.io/DataQ and rebuild so canonical/og:url/sitemap/robots match reality
items.why: All canonical URLs point to a domain serving an interstitial; crawlers and social scrapers index nothing

items.change: Generate per-page OG images (1200x630, brand template, page title + section accent) via static export, wire into generateMetadata images[]
items.why: One default og-default.png for all 727 pages, hosted on the broken domain; shares render blank/generic

items.change: Add privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible or PostHog) loaded ONLY after 'Accept analytics' consent; log search queries and form submissions as conversion events
items.why: CookieConsent offers analytics consent but nothing loads; zero visibility on traffic, funnels, dead pages

items.change: Fix dead social links (SiteFooter LinkedIn href='#') and sweep all placeholder links incl. 'System status' menu entry; create real profiles or remove entries; consider linking the existing social-*.png assets
items.why: Placeholder links erode trust on an otherwise polished site

items.change: Sitemap: derive real lastmod from git commit dates per page, drop lastmod where unknown; confirm sitemap host matches the item-3 decision; add 404 page custom <title> ('Page not found')
items.why: lastmod = build timestamp for all 727 URLs is noise for crawlers

items.change: Execute remaining P0-Images backlog: per-industry hero sets (12 industries), product-style platform mockups (8 platforms), seeded case-study visual generator (37 cases), insight header system (33 articles) — from 29 images today toward unique visuals per section
items.why: 29 images for 727 pages keeps the recycled-visual problem; biggest remaining credibility gap

items.change: Stand up info@dataqsoft.com inbox (MX + deliverability + SPF/DKIM) consistent with item-3 decision; add a second contact route (calendly/booking) on Book a Briefing
items.why: Topbar email is the only contact route once forms work; unverifiable today

items.change: Add GitHub Actions workflow: naming_ci.py gate + static export + linkcheck (all internal hrefs) + Lighthouse budget + deploy gh-pages on main; keep manual script as fallback
items.why: Deploys are a manual token script; nothing validates pushes; token must stay in repo secrets, never printed

items.change: Slim homepage: 552KB HTML — audit inlined RSC payload, deduplicate repeated SVG defs, defer below-fold hydration, set LCP image priority
items.why: Largest page in the site carries the most repeated markup

items.change: Close out P0-Motion leftovers: reduced-motion parity audit for every animation, transform/opacity-only perf budget, will-change cleanup after settle
items.why: Wave 6 added 100X motion; parity + perf hygiene never audited

items.change: A11y sweep: alt text for content-bearing images in PageImagery/PageBlocks, focus-visible ring audit, contrast pass on orange-on-dark chips, aria-labels on chart containers with text summaries
items.why: Charts are pure SVG without accessible text; 1 alt attribute total in imagery components

items.change: JSON-LD breadth audit across 727 pages: Organization + WebSite sitewide, Service on service pages, BreadcrumbList on L3+, FAQPage where FAQs exist; validate with schema validator
items.why: ld+json exists on some pages; consistency unverified at scale

items.change: Re-run sameness ratchet (content_lint_baseline.json): paragraph openers, CTA reuse, arch-node emptiness; de-templatize any metric that regressed since Wave 4 blessing
items.why: Ratchet proves regressions cannot return; baseline is stale after Waves 5-7

items.change: After item 1: group results by section (Services/Industries/Platforms), keyboard navigation, recent-query memory, analytics events on search
items.why: Search is the primary nav aid for 727 pages once it actually works

items.change: Cookie consent v2: gate analytics loader on stored choice, persist and expose revoke control, align Policy link target with privacy-policy page anchor
items.why: Consent UI exists but gates nothing and cannot be revoked

items.change: Static-site hygiene: add security.txt, verify manifest icons + apple-touch, remove dead runtime paths (prisma/db scripts, standalone server bits) from package.json for the export target, document GHPAGES=1 export command in README
items.why: Scaffold leftovers confuse the build story; manifest completeness affects PWA signals

items.change: Brand-string consistency pass: 'dataqsoft' appears in env defaults/emails/domain while brand rule is 'Dataq Software'; keep domain as infra but ensure visible copy, alt text, og metadata all read 'Dataq Software' (naming_ci.py already enforces src/public — extend to generated out/ HTML)
items.why: Mixed strings in metadata undermine the naming gate's guarantee

items.change: Refresh the 500+ backlog XLSX: mark Waves 0-7 delivered, re-baseline metrics, import this Top-20 as the active queue with owners and wave numbers
items.why: Ledger drifts from reality; next session should execute from one source of truth
